creditDef.q: What is a credit and how does it work?
creditDef.a: Credits represent real computational cost: ≈ 2 credits for a typical message with the Fast model, ≈ 7 with the Standard model, and ≈ 34 per image. When Klecx searches the web, each search adds 3 credits.

rollover.q: Do unused credits roll over to the next month?
rollover.a: No. Plan credits reset at the start of each billing period and unused credits don't carry over.

cancel.q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
cancel.a: Yes — Settings → Billing → Cancel. Your plan stays active until the end of the paid period.
cancel.aLaunchingSoon: Paid plans are launching soon. When they do, you'll be able to cancel anytime from Settings, and your plan will stay active until the end of the period you paid for.

refund.a: Cancel anytime and keep your plan until the end of the period. New subscribers get a full refund within 14 days of their first payment if they've used less than 20% of its credits. Forgot to cancel? Renewals are refunded within 7 days if you haven't used any credits since. Duplicate charges and billing errors are always refunded.
refund.aLaunchingSoon: Paid plans and subscriptions are launching soon. When billing launches, all plans include clear cancellation and refund terms.

models.a: Klecx is an independent workspace built on third-party AI models. Each model option shows its typical credit cost before you send.

privacy.q: Is my conversation data kept private?
privacy.a: Your workspaces are private by default and only visible to people you invite. We don't sell personal data. Prompts are sent to our AI model provider only to generate your answers, under terms that don't allow them to train on your data.

free.q: Can I use Klecx for free?
free.a: Yes. Every account starts with 100 free credits per month, access to our Fast model, and web search included. Collaboration is available on the Standard and Pro plans, and paid plans have higher daily limits.

collaboration.q: Who pays when collaborators use a workspace?
collaboration.a: The workspace owner's credits are used for generations within that workspace. Owners control what each invited member can do (commenting, asking side questions, or prompting).

search.a: Yes. Klecx searches the web when your prompt requires up-to-date facts or citations. Web search can also be toggled off anytime in Settings.

cta.heading: Ready to organize your AI thinking?
cta.subheading: Experience workspaces that preserve versions, support passage-level questions, and stay clean over time. Start free with 100 monthly credits — no credit card required.

pricingPage.heading: Simple, honest pricing.
pricingPage.subheading: Simple plans with clear limits. Every plan shows its credits, daily cap and features up front.

featuresPage.heading: Built for how knowledge work actually happens.
featuresPage.subheading: Standard chat interfaces assume conversations are disposable and linear. Klecx provides structure, memory, and precision for sustained thinking.
featuresPage.principlesSubheading: The deliberate decisions behind the Klecx platform.
featuresPage.p1Desc: When you regenerate or edit, earlier answers are not lost. Every response is versioned so you can always step back to inspect prior variations.
featuresPage.p2Desc: Highlighting a passage allows you to explore sub-questions in isolation. Your main workspace remains clean, focused, and free of tangents.
featuresPage.p3Desc: Klecx is an independent user interface connecting you to best-in-class third-party models. You always know what model executes your request and what each turn costs.

aboutPage.heading: Why we built Klecx
aboutPage.subheading: Chat bubbles were designed for messaging friends, not for synthesizing code, legal drafts, or multi-week research.
aboutPage.threadProblemIntro: When working with foundation models, people are constantly fighting the linear chat format:
aboutPage.threadBullet1: You regenerate an answer to get a minor variation, and the previous good response disappears forever.
aboutPage.threadBullet2: You want to ask a question about paragraph 3, so you send a reply — and the model shifts its entire attention away from the original goal.
aboutPage.threadBullet3: Related conversations are buried in a messy chronological sidebar with no way to organize work into folders or projects.
aboutPage.threadProblemOutro: Klecx replaces disposable threads with persistent Workspaces and Projects, gives every response immutable version history, and lets you ask questions directly about specific passages.
aboutPage.disclosureText: Klecx is an independent workspace built on third-party AI models. We don't own those models. We provide a specialized, developer-grade workspace client that unlocks stateful multi-turn reasoning, passage annotations, version tracking, and document exports.
aboutPage.privateText: Your workspaces are private by default and only visible to people you invite. We don't sell personal data. Prompts are sent to our AI model provider only to generate your answers, under terms that don't allow them to train on your data.
aboutPage.noFakeText: We do not display fabricated customer logos, fake user counters, or deceitful “unlimited” badges. Every price and credit metric corresponds directly to what our infrastructure and AI providers cost to run.
aboutPage.supportText: Have questions, feedback, or need enterprise support? Our support team responds to all inquiries within 3 business days.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance and who we are
paragraphs: These Terms of Service (the "Terms") are an agreement between you and {companyName}, {companyAddress} ("we", "us"). Klecx is a product of {companyName}. By creating an account or using Klecx at {appUrl}, you accept these Terms, our Privacy Policy, our Acceptable Use Policy and our Cookie Policy.

In these Terms: "Klecx" or the "Service" means the Klecx website and application; a "workspace" is a conversation with its answers, comments, questions and documents; a "project" is a group of workspaces; "credits" are the units used to pay for AI features; "content" is everything you put into Klecx (prompts, files, comments, edits); and "output" is what the AI models produce for you.

You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for everything done with your account. Tell us at {supportEmail} straight away if you think someone else has used it.

sections.heading: 4. The Service
paragraphs: Klecx is an independent workspace built on third-party AI models. We don't own those models, and we are not affiliated with or endorsed by their providers.

We improve Klecx all the time, so features can change, be added or be removed. Some features may be marked as beta; they may be less reliable and can change or end. We will tell you in advance about changes that significantly reduce what a paid plan includes.

sections.heading: 5. Credits and plans
paragraphs: AI features use credits. Each model shows its typical cost before you send a message, and the actual cost depends on the length of the request and the answer. Each plan has a daily spending cap.

Credits included in a plan are renewed at the start of each period. Unused credits do not carry over to the next period. Credits have no cash value, can't be transferred or exchanged for money, and are not refunded when they expire.

sections.heading: 6. Paid plans
paragraphs: Paid plans are not yet available. Every account currently uses the Free plan, and we don't charge you anything. Before paid plans launch, we will update these Terms with the conditions for subscriptions, renewal, cancellation and refunds.

sections.heading: 6. Subscriptions, cancellation and refunds
paragraphs: Paid plans are sold by our payment partner, Creem, which acts as the merchant of record: Creem is the seller of the subscription, processes your payment and handles invoices and sales taxes. Its terms also apply to your purchase.
Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each period until you cancel. You can cancel at any time from Settings; your plan stays active until the end of the period you have paid for.

Refunds: new subscribers get a full refund within 14 days of their first payment if they have used less than 20 % of the credits of that period. A renewal is refunded within 7 days if you haven't used any credits since it renewed. Duplicate charges and billing errors are always refunded. To ask for a refund, write to {billingEmail}.
We may change prices. We will tell you at least 30 days before a new price applies to your subscription, and you can cancel before it does.

sections.heading: 7. Collaboration
paragraphs: You can invite other people to your workspaces and projects. As the owner, your credits pay for everything that happens in your workspaces, including what your members do, except voice input, which is paid by the person who uses it. You decide what each member can do, and you can set a monthly credit limit for each of them.

Ownership of a workspace or project only moves to another person if they accept the transfer, and only if it fits their plan's member limit. If an owner has more members than their plan allows, they have 14 days to fix it; after that, the most recently added members become read-only until there is room again. Nothing is deleted.

You give us a worldwide, non-exclusive licence to host, store, process and display your content only as needed to run Klecx for you: for example to show it to the people you share it with, and to send it to our AI model providers so they can produce output.
To the extent the law allows, you own the output Klecx produces for you. Output is generated automatically and may be similar or identical to output produced for other people.

sections.heading: 11. AI output can be wrong

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: What personal data Klecx collects, why, who processes it, how long we keep it, and your rights.

sections.heading: 1. Who is responsible
paragraphs: Klecx is a product of {companyName}, {companyAddress}, which is the controller of your personal data. Contact us about privacy at {privacyEmail}.
We process personal data under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023. If you are in the European Union or the United Kingdom, you also have the rights given by the GDPR and the UK GDPR.

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
paragraphs: We collect only what we need to run Klecx:
bullets: Account: your name, email address, username, profile picture, and the profile picture from your sign-in provider if you use one.
Sign-in and security: your IP address, browser and device details, the country your connection comes from, and when each session was created and last used.

Your content: prompts, answers and their versions, your edits, comments, questions, mentions, Klecx notes, files you upload and the text extracted from them, generated documents, and the public links you create.
Collaboration: workspace and project memberships, roles and permissions, invitations, ownership transfers and the activity log of shared workspaces.

Usage and billing: your credit balance and history, which models were used and how many credits each request cost, your plan and, when paid plans are available, payment status from our payment partner. We never receive or store card numbers.
Support: the requests you send us, optional technical diagnostics you choose to attach, and any screenshots you attach.
Preferences: your interface language, the language Klecx answers in, your web search setting and your notification settings.
Voice input: your recording is sent to our AI model provider to turn it into text, and only the text is kept. We don't store the recording.
Cookies and browser storage: see our Cookie Policy.

sections.heading: 3. Why we use it
paragraphs: We use your data:
bullets: To provide Klecx and the features you use, under our contract with you (our Terms of Service).
To keep accounts and the Service secure, prevent abuse and enforce our rules, based on our legitimate interests.
To send you the emails you need, such as sign-in alerts and invitations, and the notifications you choose in Settings.
To answer your support requests.
To meet our legal obligations, for example tax and accounting rules once paid plans are available.
Where the law requires your consent, we ask for it, and you can withdraw it at any time.

sections.heading: 4. Who processes your data
paragraphs: We don't sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that help us run Klecx, under contracts that limit their use of it to providing their service to us:
afterTable: When Klecx searches the web for an answer, the search query is sent to our AI model provider's search service.
We may also disclose data when the law requires it, or to protect the rights and safety of our users and the Service.

sections.heading: 5. How AI processing works
paragraphs: To produce an answer, Klecx sends your prompt and the context it needs (earlier messages, the passage you asked about, your workspace documents and Klecx notes, and attached files) to our AI model provider. The provider uses this data only to produce the answer, and its terms don't allow it to use data sent by apps like Klecx to train its models.
Image prompts are checked by automated rules before an image is created. If a prompt is blocked, we keep only a fingerprint of it and the reason, not its text.

sections.heading: 6. International transfers
paragraphs: Our service providers process data outside Nigeria, including in the United States and the European Union. When we transfer personal data abroad, we rely on the safeguards the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 allows, such as adequacy decisions or contractual safeguards, and, for data from the EU or UK, standard contractual clauses or an equivalent mechanism.

sections.heading: 7. How long we keep it
bullets: Account data and your content: as long as your account exists.
Deleted workspaces: hidden immediately and permanently removed in a scheduled clean-up.
Sessions: until you sign out, revoke the session, or 30 days after it was last used.
Support screenshots: deleted 90 days after the request.
Support requests: for as long as we need them to help you and keep a record of the request.
Credit and billing records: as long as accounting and tax law requires.
Backups: overwritten on our hosting provider's regular rotation.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask us to give you a copy of your personal data, correct it, delete it, send it to you in a portable format, or stop or limit a use of it. Where we rely on your consent, you can withdraw it at any time.

Self-service export and account deletion aren't available in Settings yet. To use any of these rights, write to {privacyEmail} from the email address of your account; we will answer within the time the law requires. You can correct your name and settings yourself in Settings.
You can complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC) or, in the EU or UK, to your local data protection authority. We'd appreciate the chance to address your concern first.

sections.heading: 9. Security
paragraphs: We protect your data with encrypted connections (HTTPS), hashed passwords, access controls that limit each workspace to the people invited to it, private storage for uploaded files with short-lived download links, sign-in alerts and rate limits against abuse. No system is perfectly secure; if a breach affects your data, we will tell you and the authorities as the law requires.

sections.heading: 10. Children
paragraphs: Klecx is for people aged 18 and over. We don't knowingly collect data from anyone younger. If you believe a child has given us personal data, contact {privacyEmail} and we will delete it.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy. For material changes, we will tell you by email or in the app before they take effect.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use Policy
acceptableUse.subtitle: What you may not do with Klecx, how we enforce it, and how to report abuse.

sections.heading: 1. Scope
paragraphs: This policy is part of our Terms of Service. It applies to everything you do in Klecx: prompts, files, comments, invitations, public links and the output you create.

sections.heading: 2. What you may not do
paragraphs: Don't use Klecx to:
bullets: Create sexually explicit or pornographic content, or romantic or sexual role-play with the AI.
Harass, threaten, bully or defame anyone, promote violence, or spread hate against people or groups.
Create malware, find or exploit security weaknesses in systems you aren't authorised to test, phish, or carry out cyberattacks.
Commit fraud, impersonate others, steal identities or deceive people.
Break the law or help others do so.
Send spam or bulk unsolicited messages, including through invitations or mentions.
Use @mentions, invitations or shared links to harass people.
Scrape, copy or resell the Service, or use it or its output to build a competing AI model.
Get around credit, plan or rate limits or other safeguards, or share an account between several people.
Upload content that you don't have the right to use, or that infringes someone else's rights.
Hide instructions in content you share in order to manipulate the AI when other people use it (prompt injection).
Pass off AI output as your own work where that's not allowed, for example in exams or graded coursework.

sections.heading: 3. Images
paragraphs: When you create images, never request or create:
bullets: Any sexual or sexualised content involving minors.
Intimate or sexual images of real people without their consent.
Face swaps, deepfakes or other manipulation of the face or likeness of real people.
Extreme violence, or content that encourages self-harm.

sections.heading: 4. How we enforce this policy
paragraphs: Image prompts are checked by automated rules before an image is created, and blocked prompts are refused. After three blocked image prompts in one day, image creation is turned off for that account until the next day. For blocked prompts we keep only a fingerprint and the reason, not the text. Our AI model provider also applies its own safety filters to all requests, and rate limits protect the Service from abuse.

Depending on how serious a violation is, we may block the content, remove a public link, limit features, or suspend or close the account. Where reasonable, we will tell you and give you a chance to respond.

sections.heading: 5. Reporting abuse
paragraphs: To report content or behaviour that breaks this policy, including a public share link, write to {abuseEmail} with a link or description and why you think it breaks the policy. For copyright complaints, see our Terms of Service. We review reports promptly.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: The cookies and browser storage Klecx uses, and why.

sections.heading: 1. Overview
paragraphs: Klecx uses a few cookies and some storage in your browser to keep you signed in and remember your preferences. We don't use advertising or tracking cookies, and no third party sets cookies through Klecx.

sections.heading: 2. What we use
paragraphs: Essential items are needed for Klecx to work. Preference items remember your choices; Klecx still works without them.

sections.heading: 3. Managing cookies and storage
paragraphs: You can delete cookies and site data in your browser's settings at any time. If you block essential cookies, you won't be able to sign in. Clearing browser storage resets your preferences and removes unsent drafts saved in this browser.

sections.heading: 4. Changes
paragraphs: If we start using cookies for other purposes, such as analytics, we will update this policy and ask for your consent first where the law requires it.

sections.heading: 5. Contact
paragraphs: Questions about this policy: {privacyEmail}.
